// NEMA 17 motor mount bracket
// Flat flange plate with an underside boss, twin ribs, and standard motor clearances.
@settings(defaultLengthUnit = mm, kclVersion = 2.0)

plateSize = 60mm
plateThickness = 5mm
bossOuterDiameter = 32mm
bossDepth = 6mm
ribLength = 52mm
ribWidth = 6mm
ribDepth = 4mm
ribEdgeOffset = 4mm
ribOneYOffset = 17mm
ribTwoYOffset = 37mm
motorHolePitch = 31mm
motorHoleDiameter = 3.5mm
pilotClearanceDiameter = 23mm
cutStart = -7mm
cutLength = 13mm
featureOverlap = 0.5mm

baseSketch = sketch(on = XY) {
  bottomEdge = line(start = [var 0mm, var 0mm], end = [var 60mm, var 0mm])
  rightEdge = line(start = [var 60mm, var 0mm], end = [var 60mm, var 60mm])
  topEdge = line(start = [var 60mm, var 60mm], end = [var 0mm, var 60mm])
  leftEdge = line(start = [var 0mm, var 60mm], end = [var 0mm, var 0mm])
  coincident([bottomEdge.end, rightEdge.start])
  coincident([rightEdge.end, topEdge.start])
  coincident([topEdge.end, leftEdge.start])
  coincident([leftEdge.end, bottomEdge.start])
  fixed([bottomEdge.start, ORIGIN])
  horizontal(bottomEdge)
  vertical(rightEdge)
  horizontal(topEdge)
  vertical(leftEdge)
  horizontalDistance([bottomEdge.start, bottomEdge.end]) == plateSize
  verticalDistance([rightEdge.start, rightEdge.end]) == plateSize
}
baseRegion = region(
  segments = [baseSketch.bottomEdge, baseSketch.rightEdge],
  intersectionIndex = -1,
  direction = CCW,
)
basePlate = extrude(baseRegion, length = plateThickness)

bossPlane = offsetPlane(XY, offset = featureOverlap)
bossSketch = sketch(on = bossPlane) {
  bossCircle = circle(
    start = [var 46mm, var 30mm],
    center = [var 30mm, var 30mm],
  )
  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, bossCircle.center]) == plateSize / 2
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, bossCircle.center]) == plateSize / 2
  radius(bossCircle) == bossOuterDiameter / 2
}
bossRegion = region(segments = [bossSketch.bossCircle])
bossBlank = extrude(bossRegion, length = -(bossDepth + featureOverlap))

ribSketch = sketch(on = bossPlane) {
  ribOneBottom = line(start = [var 4mm, var 17mm], end = [var 56mm, var 17mm])
  ribOneRight = line(start = [var 56mm, var 17mm], end = [var 56mm, var 23mm])
  ribOneTop = line(start = [var 56mm, var 23mm], end = [var 4mm, var 23mm])
  ribOneLeft = line(start = [var 4mm, var 23mm], end = [var 4mm, var 17mm])
  coincident([ribOneBottom.end, ribOneRight.start])
  coincident([ribOneRight.end, ribOneTop.start])
  coincident([ribOneTop.end, ribOneLeft.start])
  coincident([ribOneLeft.end, ribOneBottom.start])
  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, ribOneBottom.start]) == ribEdgeOffset
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, ribOneBottom.start]) == ribOneYOffset
  horizontal(ribOneBottom)
  vertical(ribOneRight)
  horizontal(ribOneTop)
  vertical(ribOneLeft)
  horizontalDistance([ribOneBottom.start, ribOneBottom.end]) == ribLength
  verticalDistance([ribOneRight.start, ribOneRight.end]) == ribWidth

  ribTwoBottom = line(start = [var 4mm, var 37mm], end = [var 56mm, var 37mm])
  ribTwoRight = line(start = [var 56mm, var 37mm], end = [var 56mm, var 43mm])
  ribTwoTop = line(start = [var 56mm, var 43mm], end = [var 4mm, var 43mm])
  ribTwoLeft = line(start = [var 4mm, var 43mm], end = [var 4mm, var 37mm])
  coincident([ribTwoBottom.end, ribTwoRight.start])
  coincident([ribTwoRight.end, ribTwoTop.start])
  coincident([ribTwoTop.end, ribTwoLeft.start])
  coincident([ribTwoLeft.end, ribTwoBottom.start])
  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, ribTwoBottom.start]) == ribEdgeOffset
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, ribTwoBottom.start]) == ribTwoYOffset
  horizontal(ribTwoBottom)
  vertical(ribTwoRight)
  horizontal(ribTwoTop)
  vertical(ribTwoLeft)
  horizontalDistance([ribTwoBottom.start, ribTwoBottom.end]) == ribLength
  verticalDistance([ribTwoRight.start, ribTwoRight.end]) == ribWidth
}
ribOneRegion = region(
  segments = [ribSketch.ribOneBottom, ribSketch.ribOneRight],
  intersectionIndex = -1,
  direction = CCW,
)
ribTwoRegion = region(
  segments = [ribSketch.ribTwoBottom, ribSketch.ribTwoRight],
  intersectionIndex = -1,
  direction = CCW,
)
ribOne = extrude(ribOneRegion, length = -(ribDepth + featureOverlap))
ribTwo = extrude(ribTwoRegion, length = -(ribDepth + featureOverlap))

ribbedBlank = union([basePlate, bossBlank, ribOne, ribTwo])

holePlane = offsetPlane(XY, offset = cutStart)
holeSketch = sketch(on = holePlane) {
  pilotClearance = circle(
    start = [var 41.5mm, var 30mm],
    center = [var 30mm, var 30mm],
  )
  lowerLeftHole = circle(
    start = [var 16.25mm, var 14.5mm],
    center = [var 14.5mm, var 14.5mm],
  )
  lowerRightHole = circle(
    start = [var 47.25mm, var 14.5mm],
    center = [var 45.5mm, var 14.5mm],
  )
  upperLeftHole = circle(
    start = [var 16.25mm, var 45.5mm],
    center = [var 14.5mm, var 45.5mm],
  )
  upperRightHole = circle(
    start = [var 47.25mm, var 45.5mm],
    center = [var 45.5mm, var 45.5mm],
  )

  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, pilotClearance.center]) == plateSize / 2
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, pilotClearance.center]) == plateSize / 2
  radius(pilotClearance) == pilotClearanceDiameter / 2

  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, lowerLeftHole.center]) == (plateSize - motorHolePitch) / 2
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, lowerLeftHole.center]) == (plateSize - motorHolePitch) / 2
  radius(lowerLeftHole) == motorHoleDiameter / 2

  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, lowerRightHole.center]) == (plateSize + motorHolePitch) / 2
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, lowerRightHole.center]) == (plateSize - motorHolePitch) / 2
  radius(lowerRightHole) == motorHoleDiameter / 2

  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, upperLeftHole.center]) == (plateSize - motorHolePitch) / 2
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, upperLeftHole.center]) == (plateSize + motorHolePitch) / 2
  radius(upperLeftHole) == motorHoleDiameter / 2

  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, upperRightHole.center]) == (plateSize + motorHolePitch) / 2
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, upperRightHole.center]) == (plateSize + motorHolePitch) / 2
  radius(upperRightHole) == motorHoleDiameter / 2
}
pilotRegion = region(segments = [holeSketch.pilotClearance])
lowerLeftRegion = region(segments = [holeSketch.lowerLeftHole])
lowerRightRegion = region(segments = [holeSketch.lowerRightHole])
upperLeftRegion = region(segments = [holeSketch.upperLeftHole])
upperRightRegion = region(segments = [holeSketch.upperRightHole])
holeCutters = extrude(
  [
    pilotRegion,
    lowerLeftRegion,
    lowerRightRegion,
    upperLeftRegion,
    upperRightRegion
  ],
  length = cutLength,
)

motorMountBracket = subtract([ribbedBlank], tools = holeCutters)
  |> appearance(color = "#4f5963")

hide([baseSketch, bossSketch, ribSketch, holeSketch])
